title: Gate Driver IC Market Size to Surpass USD 2.91 Billion by 2035 | Research by SNS Insider
author: Sns Insider
description: The global Gate Driver IC market is expected to expand at a CAGR of 5.19% through 2035, driven by electric vehicle adoption, renewable energy infrastructure development, and advanced power electronics. title: Director Sells 10,000 Shares of this Semiconductor Stock Down 25%. Should Investors Panic?
author: Sarah Sidlow
description: Power Integrations director Balu Balakrishnan sold 10,080 shares worth ~$451,100 on Feb. 3, 2026, through an automatic tax-related transaction tied to restricted stock vesting. The sale represents 1.72% of holdings and aligns with the insider's typical trading pattern. While the stock is down 25% year-over-year, it's up 33% year-to-date. The company reported mixed Q4 results with declining revenue but improved profitability, though it announced a 7% workforce reduction as part of restructuring.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The insider sale is explained as an automatic tax-related transaction rather than a sign of lost confidence. While the stock is down 25% YoY, it's up 33% YTD. Q4 results were mixed with revenue declining but earnings improving. The 7% workforce reduction indicates restructuring challenges, but the company maintains a strong market position in power conversion technology with potential upside from AI infrastructure buildout. The overall picture suggests neither panic nor strong conviction.
